name: Financial Ledger
tagline: A chartreuse-and-ink financial report with editorial photography, executive scorecard, revenue chart, cost structure, profit bridge and scenarios.

palette.description: Neon chartreuse and near-black accounting graphics on warm paper.

typography.style: Sturdy slab-serif display headlines with crisp, compact sans-serif financial labels.

best_for: Financial reviews that need a complete narrative from executive summary through trends, mix, profit and forward scenarios.
avoid_for: Soft wellness stories, classroom lessons, or detailed statutory financial statements.
